units.text: Create an account with **Clarity**, not FACTS or SSS. Clarity is the aid platform most schools on this site use.

Section 4's weak point is how far aid reaches and how large awards are. The 50% ceiling is published, but no total awarded, no share of students, no average and no median. Gifts received into the assistance fund are published: $48,422 in 2020–21, falling to $23,798 in 2024–25. But money received is not money awarded, and one should not be read as the other.
